question: What is the primary role of diagnostic devices in nursing informatics?

options.A: Replacing the clinical judgment of the attending bedside nurse
options.B: Capturing and transmitting patient data into electronic health records
options.C: Eliminating the need for routine physical assessments completely
options.D: Managing hospital financial budgets and medical supply inventory

explanation: Diagnostic devices act as data collection tools that feed patient information directly into digital health systems. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h1)

question: Automatic data uploading from smart diagnostic devices helps to prevent which common issue?

options.A: Delays in physician medication prescription writing
options.B: Frequent electrical power outages on the ward
options.D: Patient anxiety during invasive physical exams

explanation: Direct transfer of readings from device to record bypasses manual writing mistakes made by staff. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h1)

question: A portable glucometer used at the bedside is an example of what type of testing?
explanation: Point-of-care testing brings diagnostic analysis directly to the patient location for fast clinical results. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h2)

question: Why must a nurse run control solutions on a bedside glucometer regularly?

options.A: To calibrate the internal battery voltage for prolonged shelf life
options.B: To verify that the device reads accurately before testing patients
options.C: To clean biological residue off the exterior plastic housing
options.D: To stimulate chemical reactions required for rapid blood absorption

explanation: Quality control checks ensure the testing strip and meter are functioning correctly to yield reliable patient results. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h2)

question: Which diagnostic imaging device relies on high-frequency sound waves?
explanation: Ultrasound equipment uses sound wave reflections to construct real-time visual displays of internal organs. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h3)

question: Why are ferrous metal items strictly barred from the MRI examination room?

options.A: Metal instantly blocks the transmission of diagnostic sound waves
options.B: The powerful magnetic field creates a severe projectile hazard
options.C: High electrical voltage causes immediate thermal burns on skin
options.D: Radioactive isotopes will contaminate the unsealed metallic surface

explanation: The strong magnet inside an MRI pulls iron-containing objects violently toward the core, risking severe patient injury. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h3)

question: What is the primary function of a PACS in a healthcare facility?

options.A: Calculating daily fluid input and output balances automatically
options.B: Storing and sharing digital medical images securely
options.C: Monitoring patient cardiac rhythms via telemetry alarms
options.D: Dispensing oral medications from automated pharmacy lockers

explanation: A Picture Archiving and Communication System manages the digital storage and retrieval of radiological scans. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h4)

question: How does integrating diagnostic imaging with the Hospital Information System benefit patient care?

options.A: Clinicians can view images alongside lab trends instantly
options.B: Patients can perform their own diagnostic tests at home
options.C: It eliminates the need for any physical patient assessment
options.D: Imaging equipment automatically cleans itself after scanning

explanation: System integration allows seamless correlation of various clinical data points on a single digital platform. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h4)

question: Which three principles form the core of basic radiation safety?
explanation: Minimizing time near sources, maximizing distance, and using physical barriers protect staff from radiation exposure. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h5)

question: Why is sharing a patient's diagnostic scan on personal social media a serious violation?

options.A: It automatically recalibrates the imaging machine settings
options.B: It breaches legal patient confidentiality and data privacy
options.C: It slows down the internet speed on the hospital ward
options.D: It wastes hospital printing paper and digital storage space

explanation: Patient health information is legally protected, and sharing diagnostic files outside secure networks violates ethical duties. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T1#GNS113_U4_T1_h5)
